purpose: Real portfolio mission: acquire fresh external information, carry that evidence across steps, transform it into a durable professional artifact, and verify the artifact in the same shared runtime. The mission is intentionally minimal so the first exact missing integration primitive is frozen rather than hidden behind more infrastructure.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; : "${ASTRA_STEP_0_BODY:?CROSS_STEP_EVIDENCE_NOT_EXPOSED}"; mkdir -p canonical/astra_runtime/evidence; python - <<'PY' import json, os, pathlib, re body=os.environ['ASTRA_STEP_0_BODY'] m=re.search(r'Python ([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)', body) if not m: m=re.search(r'Python ([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)', body) if not m: raise SystemExit('LATEST_VERSION_NOT_EXTRACTED') version=m.group(1) out={'source':'https://www.python.org/downloads/feed.rss','extracted_latest_version':version} pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/research_artifact_001.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n') pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/research_artifact_001.html').write_text(f'

Python release research

Latest observed Python version: {version}

Source: Python releases RSS

') PY

replay_after_root_cause_change.repair: Expose prior step results to later shell steps and decode gzip HTTP bodies

replay_after_root_cause_change_2.repair: Prefer rehydrated step results over stale history; replay external research step on resume

replay_after_parser_repair.repair: Use official machine-readable Python releases RSS feed

cross_step_boundary_repair.invariant: Later shell steps receive only explicitly declared prior-step channels. Each admitted prior result is SHA-256 content-bound before environment projection.
cross_step_boundary_repair.known_counterexample_closed: ASTRA_STEP_0_BODY remains available only because step 1 explicitly declares step 0 BODY as an input.
cross_step_boundary_repair.hard_nonclaim: This repairs the known mission-runner raw-result bypass but does not by itself prove whole-runtime P1/P2 channel completeness.
